words.defJa: 目立たず控えめなさま

cards.ja: AI業界の注目は派手な新モデルに集まりがちだが、現場の収益を支えているのは、もっと地味な仕事だという指摘もある。たとえば、請求書の読み取りや問い合わせの振り分けといった、人手に頼ってきた定型業務の自動化だ。目立たない分、導入の効果は数字で測りやすく、費用を回収するめども立てやすい。話題性より実務への適合が評価される段階に、市場は入りつつある。派手さが薄れるにつれて、本当に使われる技術が残っていくのだろう。
cards.en: Attention in the AI industry tends to gather on flashy new models, but some point out that what supports revenue on the ground is much plainer work. Examples are the automation of routine tasks that have relied on human hands, such as reading invoices and sorting inquiries. Because it is inconspicuous, the effect of adoption is easy to measure in numbers, and it is easy to see a prospect of recovering the cost. The market is entering a stage in which fit for practical use is valued over buzz. As the glitter fades, the technologies that are actually used will probably remain.

cards.tipJa: 「地味な仕事・服装・色」。派手さがなく控えめなさま。対義語は「派手」。
cards.enTarget: Attention in the AI industry tends to gather on flashy new models, but some point out that what supports revenue on the ground is much plainer work.

words.defJa: ある場所のすぐ近くの一帯

cards.ja: ガンジス河畔の聖地ヴァラナシでは、夜明け前から、人々が沐浴のために次々と川へ下りていく。ガート付近は、祭礼の時期ともなると、身動きもとれないほど混み合い、岸辺の階段は人の波で埋まる。伝統的な沐浴の習わしを守りながら、どう安全を確保するかは、巡礼地に共通する課題である。信仰の場だからこそ、規制は慎重にならざるを得ない。階段の幅や避難経路といった地味な設計が、実は巡礼の安全を左右している。
cards.en: In the holy city of Varanasi on the Ganges, people go down to the river one after another to bathe, starting before dawn. In the vicinity of the ghats, the crowds in festival season become so dense that one can hardly move, and the steps along the bank are filled with a tide of people. How to ensure safety while preserving the traditional custom of ritual bathing is a problem shared by pilgrimage sites everywhere. Precisely because it is a place of faith, regulation has no choice but to proceed with caution. Plain design matters such as the width of the steps and the evacuation routes in fact determine the safety of the pilgrimage.

cards.tipJa: 「駅付近」「現場付近」のように場所名に付き、近辺のおおよその範囲を示す。
cards.enTarget: In the vicinity of the ghats, the crowds in festival season become so dense that one can hardly move, and the steps along the bank are filled with a tide of people.

words.defJa: 味をじっくり確かめる

cards.ja: 『チャーンドーギヤ・ウパニシャッド』には、塩と水の話がある。父は息子に、塩を溶かした水を、上から、真ん中から、底から味わうよう命じるが、どこを口にしても塩辛い。塩は目に見えなくても、水の隅々まで味としてにじんでいる。それは、世界のすべてに行き渡る、目には映らない実在の比喩なのだ。見えないものを体験を通して確かめさせる、この教え方の巧みさに、私は何度読んでも唸らずにはいられない。
cards.en: The Chandogya Upanishad contains a story about salt and water. A father orders his son to taste the salt-dissolved water from the top, from the middle, and from the bottom, yet wherever he takes it, it is salty. Even though the salt cannot be seen, it seeps through every corner of the water as taste. That is a metaphor for the unseen reality that pervades everything in the world. However many times I read it, I cannot help marveling at the skill of this way of teaching, which has one confirm the unseen through experience.

words.defJa: 思い違いをすること

cards.ja: 「AIは人間のように考えている」と受け取るのは、よくある勘違いだ。現在の対話型システムは、大量の文章から言葉の並び方の規則を統計的に学んでおり、意味を理解しているかどうかは、研究者の間でも意見が割れている。それゆえ、流暢で自信に満ちた答えが出てきたとしても、内容が正しい保証にはならない。利用者に求められるのは、便利さに目を奪われず、出力を自分で確かめる冷静さである。
cards.en: Taking it that 'AI thinks like a human' is a common misunderstanding. Today's conversational systems statistically learn the rules of how words line up from vast quantities of text, and whether they understand meaning is a point on which even researchers are divided. Therefore, even when a fluent and confident answer comes out, it is no guarantee that the content is correct. What users are asked for is the composure not to be dazzled by convenience and to check the output for themselves.

words.defJa: 他人にかまわず思うままに

cards.ja: 戦国大名がつくった分国法には、家臣が主君の許しもなく、勝手に他家と縁を結ぶことを戒める条文が見られます。裏を返せば、そうした動きが現実に絶えなかったということです。同盟も婚姻も、一つ間違えれば領地そのものを危うくしかねない時代でした。だからこそ、大名は家臣の人脈にまで目を光らせ、手紙のやり取りから縁談に至るまで、できる限り把握しようとしたのです。統治とは、土地だけでなく、人のつながりを管理する仕事でもあったのでしょう。
cards.en: The house codes made by Sengoku daimyo contain provisions warning retainers against forming ties with other houses on their own, without their lord's permission. Turned around, this means such moves never actually ceased. In that age, one mistake in an alliance or a marriage could endanger the domain itself. That is exactly why daimyo kept a watchful eye even on their retainers' connections, trying to grasp everything they could, from exchanges of letters to marriage talks. Governing was probably a job of managing not only land but also the ties between people.

cards.en: In the old town of Rome, there are really a lot of zones that cars can't enter. The roads are still the old width, so the very idea of modern cars passing through is a stretch. When you walk, you get the sense of walking on cobblestones from hundreds of years ago as if it were nothing, and you can't help shivering. And right beside those cobblestones, there are just ordinary cafes and laundry hanging. It was in that city that I first felt for real that history isn't something that exists only in books.

words.defJa: あるものの周りのあたり

cards.ja: インド哲学を理解する上で、中心となる概念だけでなく、一見地味な周辺の語彙が、思いのほか物を言う。たとえば「アートマン」は、「ブラフマン」や「マーヤー」といった語との関係の中で初めて意味が立ち上がる。単語を一つずつ丸暗記するよりも、関連語を地図のようにまとめて覚えるほうが、記憶に定着しやすいとされる。学習科学の面でも、関連づけて覚えた記憶は思い出しやすいと考えられている。新しい分野を学び始めた人ほど、押さえておきたい視点である。
cards.en: In understanding Indian philosophy, not only the central concepts but also the seemingly plain surrounding vocabulary counts for more than one expects. For example, atman gains its meaning only within its relationship to words like brahman and maya. Rather than rote-memorizing words one by one, grouping related terms together like a map is said to make them stick more easily in memory. On the side of learning science too, memories formed by association are thought to be easier to recall. It is a viewpoint all the more worth keeping in mind for those who have just begun a new field.

words.defJa: 端数を決まった規則で整える方法

cards.ja: 歴史の年表を暗記するとき、四捨五入して大づかみに覚える方法があります。たとえば、フランス革命は1789年ですが、「十八世紀の終わり」と丸めておけば、前後の出来事との関係が見えやすくなります。細かい年号はとっくに忘れても、大きな流れが頭に残っている限り、必要なときに調べ直せます。覚えることよりも、全体の中に位置づけることのほうが、ずっと大切なのです。細部の正確さは、その上に少しずつ積み上げればよいのです。
cards.en: When memorizing a historical chronology, there is a way of rounding off and remembering things in broad strokes. For example, the French Revolution was in 1789, but if you round it to 'the end of the eighteenth century,' its relation to the events before and after becomes easier to see. Even if you forgot the precise years long ago, as long as the big flow remains in your head you can look things up again when needed. Placing things within the whole matters far more than memorizing them. Precision in the details can simply be piled on top of that, bit by bit.

words.defJa: まとまった領土と政府を持つ共同体を表す接尾語

cards.ja: 1973年の石油危機で、世界は、原油の値段と量を産油国が握れることを思い知らされました。第四次中東戦争を背景に、原油の供給が絞られ、価格が大きく引き上げられたのです。日本では、トイレットペーパーを買い求める人が店に殺到し、物価もにわかに跳ね上がりました。エネルギーの大半を輸入に頼る経済は、外の事情ひとつで揺らぎます。企業は省エネ技術への投資を余儀なくされ、備蓄の制度も整えられていきました。
cards.en: In the 1973 oil crisis, the world was made to realize that oil-producing nations could hold the price and quantity of crude in their hands. Against the background of the Fourth Middle East War, the supply of crude was squeezed and prices were raised sharply. In Japan, people rushed to stores to buy toilet paper, and prices suddenly leapt up as well. An economy that depends on imports for most of its energy is shaken by a single outside circumstance. Companies were forced into investing in energy-saving technology, and a system of stockpiling was also put in place.

words.defJa: 人や話の間に無理に入る

cards.ja: 会議で人の話に割り込む癖は、本人に悪気がなくても、驚くほど頻繁に起こります。相手の話の先を頭の中で先回りして予測して、答えが出た瞬間に口が動いてしまうのです。悪気がないとはいえ、予測はしばしば外れ、遮られた相手はにわかに口が重くなって、本当に必要な意見まで引っ込めてしまいます。直したいなら、まず三秒待ってみる。たったそれだけで、会議の空気は驚くほど変わります。
cards.en: The habit of cutting into other people's talk in meetings happens even without ill intent. You predict where the other person's speech is heading in your head, and the moment an answer comes out, your mouth starts moving. Even without ill intent, predictions often miss, and the person who was interrupted suddenly becomes reluctant to speak and holds back even the opinions that are really needed. If you want to fix it, first wait three seconds. Just that alone changes the mood of a meeting surprisingly much.

words.defJa: 立派で、人から敬われるさま

cards.ja: 「あの人は偉い」と言うとき、私たちは何を見ているのでしょうか。肩書きや年収を人の値打ちと勘違いしてはいないでしょうか。孔子は、地位や財産に限らず、学び続ける姿勢こそが人を立派にすると、弟子たちに繰り返し説きました。そう考えると、本当に尊敬される人ほど、自分を大きく見せようとはしないものです。むしろ、知らないことを知らないと素直に言える人にこそ、人は敬意を払うのではないでしょうか。
cards.en: When we say 'that person is great,' what are we looking at? Aren't we mistaking a title or an income for a person's worth? Confucius repeatedly taught his disciples that, beyond rank or wealth, it is the attitude of continuing to learn that makes a person admirable. Seen that way, the more truly respected a person is, the less they try to make themselves look big. Isn't it rather the person who can candidly say they don't know what they don't know that people honor?

words.defJa: 自分の行いを振り返り考えること

cards.ja: 戦後ドイツは、ナチス時代への反省を、教育と記念の両面から制度化してきた。学校の歴史教育では加害の事実を正面から扱うことが重視され、街の歩道には、犠牲者の名を刻んだ小さな真鍮のプレートが数多く埋め込まれている。こうした取り組みは、過去を忘れまいとする社会の意志の表れにほかならない。もっとも、体験者が減っていく中で、記憶の継承がどう変質していくかは、依然として課題である。
cards.en: Postwar Germany has institutionalized its reflection on the Nazi era through both education and commemoration. In school history education, facing the facts of perpetration head-on is emphasized, and on the sidewalks of towns, many small brass plaques engraved with the names of victims have been set into the ground. Such efforts are nothing other than an expression of society's will not to forget the past. Still, as those who experienced it grow fewer, how the transmission of memory will change remains an open problem.

words.defJa: 用言を修飾する品詞の一つ

cards.en: When a language model writes Japanese text, what tends to give it away is, surprisingly, the adverb. Words that adjust degree, like 'fairly,' 'somewhat,' and 'considerably,' are bound to sound unnatural as long as the reading of context is shallow. Humans read the atmosphere of the situation and their relationship to the other person, and choose among such words unconsciously. That is exactly why whether a machine can use them freely becomes a touchstone for understanding Japanese. A native speaker's sense shows itself best not in nouns or verbs but in the inconspicuous words.

cards.en: In bookstores, biographies of great figures continue to be read steadily. Not to mention the classics for children, in recent years books for adults that carefully depict the lives of business leaders and scientists, hardships and failures included, also catch the eye. Many readers seem to draw lessons less from the success stories themselves than from the scenes of failure and hesitation. The wish to follow the stumbles of those who came before is probably what keeps the page-turning hand from stopping. Being able to relive another person's life is a great strength of the book as a form.

Just because it is convenient does not mean you need not know what is inside, does it? If you know even a little about how the technology works, even how AI news looks to you changes quite a lot.

cards.ja: 話し方の悩みの多くは、実は技術よりも、日ごろの心の癖から来ている。言い間違えを、取り返しのつかない一生の失態のように大げさに受け止めてしまうのが、その典型だ。聞き手は、聞き流した言い間違いのほとんどを、数秒で忘れてしまう。言い間違えるのは当たり前だと、話す前に言い聞かせるだけでも、声は驚くほどやわらかく変わる。失敗を小さく見積もれる人ほど、次の一言を落ち着いて選べるのだ。

words.defJa: 物同士が互いに引き合う力

cards.ja: 仏教心理の解説では、執着を、心に働く引力にたとえて説明することがあります。重いものほど周りを強く引き寄せるように、強い欲望は、注意を一点へ縛りつけて簡単には離しません。ただし、この力は消すものではなく、向きを知って付き合うものです。思いが頭の中を巡るたびに、引き戻される感覚をそっと眺めて観察する。坐禅で呼吸に意識を戻し続けるのは、その練習にほかならないのです。
cards.en: Explanations of Buddhist psychology sometimes liken attachment to a gravitational pull acting on the mind. Just as heavier things pull their surroundings harder, a strong desire ties attention to a single point and will not let go. But this force is not something to eliminate; it is something to live with by knowing its direction. Each time thoughts circle through your head, you quietly observe the sensation of being pulled back. Continually returning awareness to the breath in seated meditation is nothing other than practice for that.

If you just copy the answer, you risk ending with only the feeling of having studied. Less hardship is not bad in itself, but care is needed not to let go of even the hardship that must not be reduced.

I think this can be used for organizing study and work too. Doesn't just removing one thing from your desk make your head feel suddenly lighter?

words.defJa: 他より優れている点や頼れる点

cards.ja: アドヴァイタ・ヴェーダーンタの強みは、日常の当たり前の経験を出発点にしながら、その背後にある唯一の実在へ至る道筋を示す点にある。目の前の縄を蛇と見誤るという例えは、誰にでも通じる。恐れが消えるのは、縄が別の何かに変わったからではなく、見誤りが解けたからである。この比喩が千年以上語り継がれてきたのは、説明の巧みさに加えて、体験に根ざしているからにほかならない。

The analogy of mistaking a rope in front of you for a snake is understood by anyone. Fear disappears not because the rope has turned into something else but because the mistake has dissolved. That this metaphor has been passed down for over a thousand years is, in addition to the skill of the explanation, nothing other than because it is rooted in experience.

cards.en: There is a theory that the English word for education derives from a Latin word meaning "to draw out." If that is correct, a teacher's sense of mission should lie not in cramming in knowledge but in leading out the power sleeping within the learner. Socrates' method of questioning can be said to stand squarely in that lineage. Perhaps the true teacher is not the one who gives answers but the one who nurtures questions. The courage of the teacher not to give the answer first is the very starting point of this lineage.

Small mechanisms, such as putting your phone in another room and falling asleep with your textbook open, last far longer. In fact, people who manage to avoid temptation are said to be not those who beat temptation but those who choose places where they do not meet it in the first place. Do not count on grit; letting the environment do the work is the shortcut.

cards.en: Japanese has no grammatical gender in its nouns. Even so, sentence-final expressions such as "wa" and "ze" call to mind whether the speaker is male or female. Moreover, the reality of how people actually speak is not that simple. These have a strong aspect of being "role language," shaped in novels and manga to convey a character's image. That a professor or an old man speaks with "-ja," for example, is also something that has soaked into our ears as a convention of stories rather than as actual speech.

cards.ja: 人間の学習には、実は三階建ての構造があるといわれます。いちばん下の基盤にあたるのが、睡眠と運動という当たり前の土台です。その上に毎日の習慣が乗り、さらにその上に、知識や技術が少しずつ積み上がっていきます。朝の十分間の散歩や、夜ふかしをやめる小さな決心を、軽く見てはいけません。土台が崩れかけているのに、新しい勉強法ばかり磨いても、成果が伸びるわけがありません。
cards.en: Human learning is said to have a three-story structure. The foundation at the very bottom is the obvious base of sleep and exercise. On top of that sit daily habits, and above them knowledge and skills pile up little by little. Do not underestimate a ten-minute morning walk or the small resolve to stop staying up late. If the footing is already crumbling, there is no way results will grow just from polishing new study methods.

By contrast, Africa and the Americas run north to south, and he says differences in climate hindered the spread of crops. Of course, just because it runs east to west does not mean everything is decided. But isn't it fascinating that you can see the mechanism just by looking at a map? Even if geography is not destiny, you can't ignore it as the stage setting.

words.meaning: to swagger, to lord it over
words.defJa: 偉そうに振る舞うこと

cards.ja: 古代ローマの属州では、徴税を請け負った民間業者が、取り立ての強引さで住民の反感を買った。権力を笠に着て威張る者が現れれば、不満は一気に広がる。そのため、総督による監督は、統治の安定を左右する課題となっていた。とはいえ、遠い属州で目を光らせ続けるのは、容易ではなかったと考えられる。遠い属州の住民にとって、ローマとは、結局のところ、目の前の徴税人の顔にほかならなかったのだろう。
cards.en: In the provinces of ancient Rome, private contractors who took on tax collection earned the resentment of residents through their forceful collecting. Once someone who swaggered, trading on his power, appeared, discontent spread all at once. Supervision by the governor therefore became an issue that shaped the stability of rule. Even so, it is thought that keeping a watchful eye in a distant province was not easy. For residents of a far province, Rome may in the end have been nothing other than the face of the tax collector before their eyes.

cards.en: In language there is an aspect in which meanings circulate. For example, "yabai" was originally slang for inconvenience or danger, but now it is also used for the praise "amazing," isn't it? As the praising sense spreads, the original bad sense becomes less noticeable, and another word takes over the role of "danger." This repeated swapping is the mechanism that keeps a language young. Even when a new buzzword soon vanishes, the pattern of expression returns again in a changed form.

words.defJa: まとまった形や状態をこわすこと

cards.ja: ローマの皇帝たちは、大規模な軍を養うために、銀貨に含まれる銀の量をじりじり減らしました。目先の出費は乗り切れても、貨幣への信頼を崩すことになり、物価は上がり続けます。これが三世紀の混乱の一因だったと考えられています。信用が一度落ちると、立て直すのに何十年もかかりかねません。通貨の信用を守ることは、軍事力を保つことと同じくらい、国家の根幹にかかわる仕事だったのです。
cards.en: To support a large army, Roman emperors steadily reduced the amount of silver in their coins. They could get through immediate expenses, but this undermined trust in the currency, and prices kept rising. This is thought to have been one cause of the turmoil of the third century. Once credit falls, rebuilding it could take decades. Protecting the credit of the currency was work as basic to the state as maintaining military power.

Incidentally, the monism Advaita teaches is distinguished, even within Vedanta, as a position different from dualism and qualified non-dualism. As a rough map, the dividing line is not the merits of the teachings but nothing other than the attitude toward scripture.

If you focus only on the power of self-restraint, you may well overlook the influence of environment. When reading figures, one wants to get into the habit of checking even who investigated them and under what conditions.

The question is how to reconcile authors' rights with technological development.

In fact, people used to speaking in public cut back boldly, at the preparation stage, the content they wanted to cram in. Rather than getting rid of nerves, reducing room for hesitation is far more reliable.

Where something feels off when read aloud, go back to your own words without hesitation. If you swallow each edit the instant it is made, your writing drifts toward the average. A text that is correct on average stays in no one's memory.

words.defJa: やるべきことをしないでおくこと

cards.ja: 2018年、米アリゾナ州で、自動運転の試験車が歩行者をはねて死亡させる事故が起きた。米国の運輸安全委員会は、安全運転手が前方の監視を怠っていたことに加え、運営会社の安全体制にも不備があったと指摘している。機械に任せきりになる心理は、技術が優れているほど強まるとされる。人と機械の役割分担をどう設計するかが、いま改めて問われている。安全は、意識して設計しなければ、技術の進歩だけでは保証されないのである。
cards.en: In 2018 in Arizona, an autonomous test vehicle struck and killed a pedestrian. The US National Transportation Safety Board pointed out that, in addition to the safety driver neglecting to watch ahead, there were also deficiencies in the operating company's safety system. The tendency to leave everything to the machine is said to grow stronger the better the technology is. How to design the division of roles between people and machines is being asked afresh now. Safety is not guaranteed by technological progress alone unless it is deliberately designed.

cards.tipJa: 「注意を怠る」「確認を怠る」。当然すべきことをしない。
cards.enTarget: The US National Transportation Safety Board pointed out that, in addition to the safety driver neglecting to watch ahead, there were also deficiencies in the operating company's safety system.

words.defJa: 僧が住み修行や礼拝を行う建物

cards.ja: 記憶の宮殿という方法では、よく知っている建物を頭の中で歩き、各部屋に覚えたい物を置いていきます。たとえば、毎年訪れる寺院を思い浮かべ、門、本堂、鐘楼の順に単語を一つずつ置くのです。場所の順番がそのまま思い出す順番になる仕掛けなので、忘れかけた項目も手繰り寄せやすくなります。ただし、細かく作り込みすぎると、準備だけで疲れてしまいます。慣れてくると、旅先の街並みさえ記憶の置き場になります。
cards.en: In the method of the memory palace, you walk through a familiar building in your head and place things you want to remember in each room. For example, you picture a temple you visit every year and set one word each at the gate, the main hall and the bell tower, in that order. Because the order of places becomes the order of recall, even items you are starting to forget are easier to pull back. However, if you build it too elaborately, preparation alone will wear you out. Once you get used to it, even the streets of a travel destination become a place to store memories.

cards.enTarget: For example, you picture a temple you visit every year and set one word each at the gate, the main hall and the bell tower, in that order.

words.defJa: とくに優れた点がなくありふれた様子

cards.ja: 成功した人の習慣を細かく調べると、意外なほど平凡です。早く起きる、毎日同じ時間に机に向かう、散歩をする。どれも当たり前すぎて、本に書く価値すらないと思われがちです。たとえば小説家の村上春樹さんは、毎朝早くに起きて数時間書き、午後は走るという日課を、長年変えなかったと自著で語っています。ところが、その地味な行いを何年も一日も欠かさず続けられる人は、実はごくわずかなのです。
cards.en: When you look into the habits of successful people, they are surprisingly ordinary. They wake early, sit at the desk at the same time, and take walks. All of it is so obvious that people tend to think it is not even worth writing in a book. Novelist Haruki Murakami, for example, has said in his own books that he kept for many years a routine of rising early each morning to write for several hours and running in the afternoon. Yet the people who can keep up such plain actions for years without fail are in fact very few.

cards.enTarget: When you look into the habits of successful people, they are surprisingly ordinary.

words.defJa: 学生や社員が共同で暮らす宿舎

cards.ja: 旧制高校の寮は、寝泊まりの場であるのみならず、若者が議論と歌声で互いを鍛える共同体であった。そこでは、教師よりも、先輩や同室の仲間から多くを学んだ者が少なくなかったという。伝統的に守られてきた自治の気風も、そうした暮らしの中で育まれた。知識は書物からも得られるが、人との摩擦からしか得られない種類の学びがある。自分の部屋の外にこそ学びの場があることを、昔の学生たちは身をもって知っていたのだろう。
cards.en: The dormitories of the old-system higher schools were not only places to sleep but communities where young men trained one another through debate and song. It is said that not a few learned more from seniors and roommates than from teachers. The spirit of self-government that was traditionally maintained was also nurtured in such daily life. Knowledge can come from books, but there is a kind of learning obtained only through friction with people. Students of old probably knew firsthand that the place for learning lay outside their own rooms.

cards.enTarget: The dormitories of the old-system higher schools were not only places to sleep but communities where young men trained one another through debate and song.

words.defJa: 形や中身を作り変えること

cards.ja: 古い町家を改造して自習室にする取り組みが、各地で見られる。もとは空き家で、屋根は傷み、床は抜けかけていることも多い。改修に際しては、昔の梁をそのまま残し、静かに集中できる空間づくりが優先される。利用者の多くは、毎日同じ席に通うことを日課にしているという。住み手のいなくなった家を壊してしまうのではなく、新しい用途で生き返らせるという発想は、町並みを守ることにもつながっている。
cards.en: Efforts to remodel old townhouses into study rooms can be seen in various places. They were originally vacant houses, and often the roof is damaged and the floor is on the verge of caving in. In renovation, the old beams are left as they are and priority goes to creating a space where one can concentrate quietly. Many users are said to make going to the same seat every day their routine. The idea of reviving a house whose residents are gone for a new use, rather than tearing it down, also leads to protecting the townscape.

cards.enTarget: Efforts to remodel old townhouses into study rooms can be seen in various places.

words.defJa: 物事が進む途中の区切り

cards.ja: インドの古典音楽の師匠は、最初のうちは弟子に基本の音階ばかりを歌わせるといいます。段階を飛ばして華やかな技巧に走れば、基礎の音程が崩れるからです。話し方の修業も同じで、発声、間、抑揚という順に身につけていくのが近道になります。焦ることなく一つずつ積み重ねる態度は、遠回りに見えて、実は最も確実な道です。どんな技芸にも、それぞれの時期に必要な練習と我慢があるといわれます。
cards.en: Masters of classical Indian music are said to have their pupils sing mostly basic scales at first. If you skip stages and rush to showy technique, the foundation of pitch collapses. Training in speaking is the same: acquiring voice, pauses and intonation in that order is the shortcut. An attitude of piling up one thing at a time without hurrying looks like a detour but is in fact the surest path. It is said that every art has the practice and patience needed at each period.

cards.enTarget: If you skip stages and rush to showy technique, the foundation of pitch collapses.

words.defJa: 少しずつ、だんだん変わっていくさま

cards.ja: 文章を磨くのは、AIに添削を頼むのと似ている。最初は誤字や文法の指摘ばかりが目立つが、直された箇所を自分で見直すうちに、次第に直される前に気づけるようになる。これは上達の典型的な形だ。ただし、添削結果をそのまま採用し続けるだけでは、自分の悪癖を知る機会を失ってしまう。そのとき大切なのは、提案を鵜呑みにするのではなく、なぜそう直されたのかを自分の言葉で説明してみる習慣を持つことだ。
cards.en: Polishing your writing is similar to asking an AI for corrections. At first the pointed-out typos and grammar errors stand out, but as you review the corrected spots yourself, you gradually come to notice them before they are fixed. This is the typical shape of improvement. However, if you merely keep adopting the corrections as they are, you lose the chance to learn your own bad habits. What matters then is not swallowing the suggestions whole but having the habit of explaining in your own words why it was corrected that way.

words.defJa: はっきり見えないが感じられる様子

cards.ja: 日本語では、話し手が何も言わなくても、場の気配を読んで察することが美徳とされてきました。「空気を読む」という表現は、まさにその文化を象徴しています。ただ、言葉で意図を明示する文化とは対照的なため、外国人学習者にとってこの察しの文化は大きな壁になります。言葉に出されない意図を読み取る作業は、語彙や文法にもまして、場数を踏んで身につけるしかないのです。それを欠点と見るか、味わいと見るかで、日本語との付き合い方は変わってきます。
cards.en: In Japanese, it has been considered a virtue to read the atmosphere of the occasion and sense things even when the speaker says nothing. The expression reading the air symbolizes precisely that culture. But because it contrasts with cultures that state intentions in words, this culture of intuiting is a big wall for foreign learners. The work of reading unspoken intentions can only be acquired by gaining experience, even more than vocabulary and grammar. Whether you see it as a flaw or as a flavor changes how you deal with Japanese.

cards.enTarget: In Japanese, it has been considered a virtue to read the atmosphere of the occasion and sense things even when the speaker says nothing.

words.defJa: しずくになった小さな水のつぶ

cards.ja: 朝、窓ガラスに付いた水滴がゆっくりと集まり、一筋となって流れ落ちていく。その様子をただ眺めていると、不思議なことに、頭の中のざわめきが静まっていることに気づく。仏教の修行者が呼吸や音に意識を向けるのも、こうして注意を一点に預けるためだったのだろう。思考を止めようと力むよりも、何かを静かに見つめるほうが、心は案外早く落ち着くものである。雨上がりの庭で、葉の先に光るしずくを眺める時間こそ、いちばんの贅沢かもしれない。
cards.en: In the morning, the water drops on the window glass slowly gather and run down as a single streak. Merely watching, you notice, strangely, that the clamor in your head has quieted. Buddhist practitioners turn their awareness to breath or sound probably in order to entrust their attention to a single point in just this way. Rather than straining to stop thought, quietly gazing at something calms the mind surprisingly fast. Perhaps the time spent gazing at drops shining at leaf tips in a garden after rain is the greatest luxury.

words.defJa: 思っていたのと違い、意外なさま

cards.ja: AIに勉強を教えてもらうと、案外つまずくのは質問のしかたのほうだ。「教えて」とだけ打ち込んでも、返ってくるのは平均的な説明にとどまる。自分の理解度と目的を伝えれば、答えはそれに応じて見違えるほど的確になる。AIの性能を云々する前に、問いを立てる力を磨くほうが近道だろう。実際、同じ質問でも、自分の立場や背景を一行足すだけで、返ってくる内容の深さが変わることは珍しくない。
cards.en: When you have an AI teach you, it is surprisingly the way you ask questions that trips you up. Even if you type in just teach me, what comes back stays at an average explanation. If you convey your level of understanding and your goal, the answer becomes strikingly precise accordingly. Before debating the AI's performance, honing your ability to frame questions is probably the shortcut. In fact, even with the same question, it is not rare for the depth of what comes back to change just by adding a line about your position and background.

cards.enTarget: When you have an AI teach you, it is surprisingly the way you ask questions that trips you up.

words.defJa: ほかと比べて特に際立っていること

cards.ja: 日本語には、「特別」「特に」「とりわけ」など、際立ちを表す言葉が揃っています。その中で格別という語は、味や景色を最大級に褒める場面で好まれ、改まった響きを持ちます。ただ「特に」というより少し硬いため、日常の軽い会話ではやや重く聞こえることもあります。同じ意味でも、場面に合った語を選べるかどうかが、上級者の分かれ目です。言葉の選び方一つで、同じ景色の褒め言葉が、ありふれたものにも特別なものにも変わる。
cards.en: Japanese has plenty of words that express standing out, such as special, especially and above all. Among them, the word kakubetsu is favored for praising a taste or a view in the highest terms and carries a formal ring. But because it is a little stiffer than especially, it can sound somewhat heavy in light everyday conversation. Even with the same meaning, whether you can pick the word that suits the situation is what separates advanced learners. With the choice of a single word, praise for the same scenery can become either commonplace or special.

cards.enTarget: Among them, the word kakubetsu is favored for praising a taste or a view in the highest terms and carries a formal ring.

words.defJa: 研究のために集めた見本

cards.ja: 国立国語研究所が構築した『現代日本語書き言葉均衡コーパス』は、日本語の実態を知るに足る大規模な標本である。新聞や書籍、ブログなど多様な文章から集めた約一億語が収められ、語の使われ方を統計的に調べることができる。研究者はこれを用いて、辞書にはない微妙な使い分けを明らかにしてきた。オンラインで検索できるシステムも整備されている。言葉を集めて数え、並べて眺めるという地道な作業が、日本語研究の土台になっている。
cards.en: The Balanced Corpus of Contemporary Written Japanese, built by the National Institute for Japanese Language and Linguistics, is a large-scale specimen sufficient for learning the realities of Japanese. It holds about one hundred million words gathered from varied texts such as newspapers, books and blogs, and lets users study statistically how words are used. Researchers have used it to reveal fine distinctions in usage that dictionaries lack. A system searchable online has also been set up. The steady work of collecting words, counting them and laying them side by side to look at is the groundwork of research on Japanese.

words.defJa: 物事を進める基本の方向や考え方

cards.ja: 人材不足への対策として、企業が従業員に学び直しを促す方針を打ち出すケースが増えている。背景にあるのは、技術の進歩に伴って、仕事に必要な知識の寿命が短くなっているという認識だ。研修費の補助に加えて、勤務時間内に学習時間を確保する会社もある。ただし、制度を整えるだけでは足りず、現場の上司が学びを後押しできるかどうかが成否を分ける。この流れは、今後さらに広がるとみられている。
cards.en: As a countermeasure to labor shortages, a growing number of companies are announcing a policy of encouraging employees to relearn. Behind this is the recognition that, as technology advances, the lifespan of the knowledge needed for work is getting shorter. In addition to subsidizing training costs, some firms secure study time within working hours. However, setting up a system is not enough, and whether frontline supervisors can back the learning decides success or failure. This trend is expected to spread further from now on.

words.defJa: あらかじめ決めて、それと定めること

cards.ja: 歴史の試験でよく見かける「指定語句を使って説明せよ」という問題は、実は思考力を試す形式だ。与えられた言葉を、因果関係に沿って並べ替えることが求められるからである。たとえば「植民地」「綿花」「産業革命」が出たなら、まず時間の順に整理するとよい。いきなり書き出すのではなく、設問の意図をつかむ段階が得点を大きく左右する。答案の最初の一行に、用語どうしの関係を示す結論を置けると、あとは筆が自然に進む。
cards.en: The question often seen in history exams, to explain using the designated terms, is in fact a format that tests thinking ability. It demands that you rearrange the given words along lines of cause and effect. If colony, cotton and Industrial Revolution appear, for example, it is best to organize them in time order first. Rather than starting to write at once, the stage of grasping the intent of the question greatly affects your score. If you can place in the first line of your answer a conclusion showing how the terms relate, the pen moves on naturally from there.

words.defJa: 学校の敷地にある広い遊び場

cards.ja: 「校庭」と「運動場」と「グラウンド」は、同じ場所を指すのに微妙に響きが違う。最初の語は学校の敷地内の広場という感じが強く、遊びや集会の場面とよく結びつく。逆に「グラウンド」は、野球やサッカーなど競技の場という色合いが濃い。類義語を学ぶときは、標準的な辞書の説明だけに頼らず、どんな場面で耳にするかを一緒に覚えるのが効果的だ。こうした微妙な差は、実際の用例を何十も読むうちに、自然と感覚として身についていく。
cards.en: School yard, athletic field and ground refer to the same place yet differ subtly in feel. The first word has the strongest sense of an open space within school grounds and is often linked to play and assemblies. Conversely, ground carries a strong coloring of a venue for competition such as baseball or soccer. When learning near-synonyms, it is effective to memorize in what situations you hear each, rather than relying only on a standard dictionary's explanation. Such subtle differences become a natural sense as you read dozens of actual examples.

words.defJa: 駅で乗客が通る出入り口

cards.ja: 顔認証で開く改札口の実験が、各国の都市で進められている。利用者は切符もカードも取り出さずに通過でき、混雑の緩和が期待される。一方で、顔のデータの扱いをめぐっては、個人情報の保護に懸念を示す声も根強い。導入に際しては、利用者の同意と消去の期限を明確にし、対策を整える方針が欠かせないだろう。便利さと安心をどう両立させるのか、各国の試みはいずれもまだ手探りの段階にあるのが実情だ。
cards.en: Experiments with ticket gates that open by face recognition are under way in cities in various countries. Users can pass without taking out a ticket or card, and eased congestion is expected. On the other hand, over how face data is handled, concern about personal-information protection remains strong. At the time of introduction, a policy of making user consent and deletion deadlines clear and preparing safeguards will be indispensable. How to reconcile convenience with security remains a matter of groping in the dark in every country's attempts, in reality.

words.defJa: 用事が多く落ち着かない様子

cards.ja: インドに着いた初日は、とにかく慌ただしかったよ。デリーの駅で荷物は取られかけるし、リキシャの運転手とは値段でもめるしさ。そんなときに、道端で瞑想してるおじいさんを見かけて、なんかふっと安堵したんだよね。あの静けさは、混乱のただ中にいたからこそ強く感じられたんだと思う。結局その日は、宿に着くなり倒れ込むように眠ってしまって、楽しみにしていた夕飯も食べそびれたまま朝を迎えたんだよね。
cards.en: The first day after I got to India was hectic, no matter how you look at it. At Delhi station my bag nearly got stolen, and I was haggling over the fare with a rickshaw driver. Right then I spotted an old man meditating by the roadside, and somehow I felt a wave of relief. I think I felt that stillness so strongly precisely because I was in the thick of the chaos. In the end, the moment I reached the inn I collapsed into sleep, and I woke up the next morning having missed even the dinner I'd been looking forward to.

cards.enTarget: The first day after I got to India was hectic, no matter how you look at it.

words.defJa: 意見や苦情を新聞などに書き送ること

cards.ja: ガンディーは新聞への投書を、自分の考えを広める道具として活用した人でした。植民地下の南アフリカでインド人の権利を訴えていた頃、彼は現地の新聞に何度も手紙を送っています。のちには自ら『インディアン・オピニオン』という週刊紙まで創刊しました。一通の手紙から始まった発言は、やがて大衆を動かす運動へと育っていきました。活字になった言葉が人から人へ伝わっていく力を、彼は誰よりも早く見抜いていたのです。
cards.en: Gandhi was a man who used letters to the editor as a tool for spreading his ideas. When he was pleading for the rights of Indians in colonial South Africa, he sent letters to local newspapers again and again. Later he even founded a weekly paper of his own, Indian Opinion. A statement that began as a single letter grew, in time, into a movement that moved the masses. He saw, earlier than anyone, the power of printed words to travel from person to person.

words.defJa: まっすぐ向き合う側。物の表側

cards.ja: 正面から向き合うことを避け続けた問題は、時間とともに形を変えて戻ってくる。心理学では、これを回避行動の悪循環として説明する。不安な場面を避けると一時的に楽になるが、避ければ安心できるどころか、不安はかえって強まるのだ。治療の現場では、段階を踏んで少しずつ状況に慣れていく方法が標準的に用いられている。完全に克服する必要はなく、まず小さな一歩だけ近づくことが回復の出発点になる。
cards.en: A problem we keep avoiding facing head-on comes back over time in a changed form. Psychology explains this as a vicious circle of avoidance behavior. Avoiding an anxious situation brings temporary relief, but far from being safe once avoided, the anxiety actually grows stronger. In treatment settings, a method of getting used to the situation little by little, step by step, is used as standard practice. There is no need to overcome it completely; taking just one small step closer is the starting point of recovery.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「正面から向き合う」「正面玄関」。真っ向から対する意味。
cards.enTarget: A problem we keep avoiding facing head-on comes back over time in a changed form.

words.defJa: 力のかぎり一生けんめいなこと

cards.ja: 一七八九年のフランスでは、パンの値上がりに苦しむ民衆が、懸命に働いて暮らしを支えようとしていた。しかし財政の悪化は止まらず、国王は三部会の招集に踏み切らざるを得なかった。三部会はやがて国民議会へと姿を変え、革命の出発点となる。当時の人々が求めたのは、単なる救済にとどまらず、社会の構造そのものの見直しだった。彼らにとってパンは、食べ物である以前に、明日を生き延びるための命綱だった。
cards.en: In France in 1789, the common people, suffering from rising bread prices, were working desperately to keep their households going. But the deterioration of the finances would not stop, and the king had no choice but to convene the Estates General. The Estates General soon changed form into the National Assembly and became the starting point of the Revolution. What people of that time wanted was not mere relief but a review of the very structure of society. For them, bread was, before it was food, a lifeline for surviving until tomorrow.

words.defJa: 判断や比べるもとになる基準

cards.ja: 江戸時代の日本には、全国どこでも通じる共通の話し言葉がなかったんですよ。薩摩の人と津軽の人が出会っても、話が通じなかったと言われています。だから藩の違う者どうしは、候文という書き言葉で意思を伝え合っていたらしいんです。明治になって国が標準となる言葉づくりを急いだのは、国民意識の基盤を築くうえで避けて通れなかったからなんですよね。共通の言葉は便利である反面、土地ごとの響きを少しずつ消していったんですよね。
cards.en: In Edo-period Japan, there was no common spoken language that worked everywhere in the country. Even when a person from Satsuma met one from Tsugaru, they are said to have been unable to understand each other. So people from different domains apparently communicated in the written language of sorobun style. The reason the state hurried to create a standard language in the Meiji era is that it was unavoidable when laying the foundation for national consciousness. A common language was convenient, but on the other hand it gradually erased the sound of each locality.

words.defJa: 乱暴にふるまい、荒れ回る

cards.ja: 史料に「蛮族が各地で暴れる」と書かれていても、一度立ち止まってほしい。ローマ人が「蛮族」と呼んだゲルマン人は、実際には農耕を営み、ローマ軍に雇われる者も多かった。移動の背景には、気候の変化やフン人の圧迫があったとされる。ラベルを覚えるのみならず、その裏の実情を問う習慣が、歴史の記憶を深くする。ある民族を最初から悪者と決めつけるような記述には、書き手の立場が隠れていることが多い。
cards.en: Even when a source says barbarians ran wild in various regions, I want you to pause. The Germanic peoples whom the Romans called barbarians in fact farmed, and many were hired by the Roman army. Behind their movement are said to lie climate change and pressure from the Huns. The habit of asking about the real circumstances behind a label, not merely memorizing it, deepens your memory of history. In accounts that write off a people as villains from the start, the writer's own standpoint is often hidden.

cards.enTarget: Even when a source says barbarians ran wild in various regions, I want you to pause.

words.defJa: ためらわずにすぐ取りかかるさま

cards.ja: 本書の著者は、瞑想を始めたいなら、まず今日の夜に五分だけ座ってみなさい、と勧めています。決意を固めるより先に、早速やってみることが習慣化の鍵だというのです。インド由来の瞑想法に限らず、新しい行動は始めるまでの心理的な壁が一番高いと著者は述べます。完璧な準備を待つのは、むしろ逆効果なのです。実際に、思い立ったその日のうちに五分でも座った人だけが、一年後には違う景色を眺めているものです。
cards.en: The author of this book recommends that if you want to start meditating, you should first just sit for five minutes tonight. Before firming up your resolve, trying it right away is the key to forming a habit, he says. Not only with meditation methods of Indian origin, the author states, but with any new behavior, the psychological wall before starting is the highest. Waiting for perfect preparation is, if anything, counterproductive. In fact, only those who sat for even five minutes on the very day they thought of it are looking at a different view a year later.

cards.enTarget: Before firming up your resolve, trying it right away is the key to forming a habit, he says.

words.defJa: 毎日きまって行う仕事や行い

cards.ja: 毎朝三十分だけ、AIに英語で日記の添削を頼む。これを日課にして三か月になる人は、書く量が自然に増えたと話す。ポイントは、完璧な文を目指さず、まず書いてから直してもらう順序にあるという。習慣の研究でも、行動を始めるハードルを下げるほど継続しやすいことが知られており、この方法はその原則に沿っている。続けるコツは、気合に頼ることではなく、起きる時間と座る場所をあらかじめ決めておくことにある。
cards.en: Every morning, for just thirty minutes, you ask an AI to correct your English diary. A person who has made this a daily routine for three months says the amount they write has grown naturally. The point, they say, lies in the order: not aiming for a perfect sentence, but writing first and having it fixed afterward. Habit research also shows that lowering the hurdle to start makes it easier to continue, and this method follows that principle. The knack for continuing lies not in relying on willpower but in deciding beforehand the time you get up and the place you sit.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「日課にする」「朝の日課」。毎日決まって行う行いを指す。
cards.enTarget: A person who has made this a daily routine for three months says the amount they write has grown naturally.

words.defJa: 部分が組み合わさってできた全体の仕組み

cards.ja: 長い文が読みにくいのは、文字数のせいではなく、構造が見えないからだ。主語と述語の距離が遠いのはもちろん、修飾語が何重にも重なると、読み手は途中で迷子になる。そこで有効なのが、一文に一つの情報だけを入れるという原則である。下書きの段階で声に出して読み、息が続かない箇所で文を切ってみると、驚くほど整う。短く切った文を並べても単調にならないよう、接続の言葉で流れをつなぐと読みやすさが増す。
cards.en: Long sentences are hard to read not because of the character count but because the structure can't be seen. Not only when the subject and predicate are far apart but when modifiers pile up in layers, the reader gets lost midway. What works then is the principle of putting only one piece of information in each sentence. If at the draft stage you read aloud and cut the sentence where your breath runs out, it comes together surprisingly well. To keep short sentences from becoming monotonous when lined up, linking the flow with connecting words increases readability.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「文の構造」「社会構造」。部分の組み合わせでできる仕組み。
cards.enTarget: Long sentences are hard to read not because of the character count but because the structure can't be seen.

words.defJa: 思いがけないことで落ち着きを失う

cards.ja: ヨーガの先生が言うには、突然のトラブルに慌てる人ほど呼吸が浅くなるそうです。たとえば電車に乗り遅れそうになると、人は無意識に息を止めているんですって。だから焦りそうなときこそ、まず長く息を吐くのがいいらしいですよ。私も先週、鍵を失くして大騒ぎしたあげく、結局ポケットの中にあったんですけどね。それ以来、毎朝五分だけ息を長く吐く練習を日課にしているんですけど、これが案外よく効くんですよ。
cards.en: According to my yoga teacher, the more a person panics at sudden trouble, the shallower their breathing becomes. When you are about to miss a train, for example, people apparently hold their breath without realizing it. So just when you feel rushed, it seems best to start by exhaling for a long time. Last week I made a huge fuss over a lost key, and in the end it was in my pocket all along. Since then I've made a five-minute practice of exhaling slowly every morning a daily routine, and it works better than you'd expect.

words.defJa: 実際にはなく、頭で作り上げたこと

cards.ja: 機械学習の授業で最初に教わるのは、モデルが「架空の事実」を自信たっぷりに語ることがある、という注意だ。これは嘘をつくというより、もっともらしい言葉の並びを予測した結果にすぎない。だから重要な情報は、安易に鵜呑みにせず、必ず出典に当たって確かめたい。この習慣こそが、AIを使いこなす学習者と振り回される学習者を分ける。出典を確かめる手間を惜しまない人ほど、AIを道具として上手に使いこなせる。
cards.en: The first thing taught in a machine-learning class is the warning that a model may confidently speak of imaginary facts. This is less a matter of lying than the result of predicting a plausible string of words. So for important information, we want to avoid swallowing it whole and always check the source. This very habit divides learners who master AI from those who are pushed around by it. The people who spare no effort in checking sources are the ones who use AI skillfully as a tool.

words.defJa: 形や数をそろいの状態にする

cards.ja: 文章を書くとき、語尾を揃えるのは基本中の基本だ。「です・ます」と「だ・である」が混ざると、読み手は無意識に違和感を覚える。わざと崩す技法もあるが、それは基本を身につけた上での話である。まず一段落ごとに大まかに文体を確認する習慣をつければ、文章の安定感は格段に増すだろう。さらに、漢字とひらがなの割合や読点の打ち方まで統一すれば、一つの声で書かれた文章として読み手に信頼される。
cards.en: When writing, making the sentence endings consistent is the basic of basics. When the polite and plain styles get mixed, the reader senses a discomfort without realizing it. There are techniques of breaking the rule on purpose, but that is a matter for after you have mastered the basics. If you build the habit of roughly checking the style one paragraph at a time, the stability of your prose will increase markedly. Furthermore, if you unify even the ratio of kanji to hiragana and the way you place commas, the text earns the reader's trust as writing in a single voice.

words.defJa: 目印として立てたり掲げたりするもの

cards.ja: 話の途中で「ところで」「たとえば」「要するに」と言うと、聞き手は次に何が来るのかを予測できる。こうした接続の言葉は、話の道筋を示す標識の役目を果たしている。道しるべ抜きにして進む話は、内容が良くても聞き手を疲れさせてしまう。だから話し慣れた人ほど、大まかな道筋を最初に示し、さりげなく目印を置きながら話を進めている。そう考えると、話し方の上達とは、聞き手が迷わない地図を描く技術なのだとも言える。
cards.en: When you say by the way, for example or in short midway through a talk, listeners can predict what is coming next. Such connecting words serve as signs marking the route of the talk. A talk that proceeds without signposts tires listeners even if the content is good. That is why practiced speakers show a rough route first and move forward while quietly placing markers. Seen this way, improving as a speaker could also be called the skill of drawing a map on which listeners do not get lost.

words.defJa: 値段や大きさがちょうどよいこと

cards.ja: ローマ時代の人たちが毎日通ってた公衆浴場って、料金がめちゃくちゃ手頃だったらしいんだよ。庶民でも気軽に行けるように、入場料はごく少額に抑えられてたんだって。しかも浴場は体を洗う場所であるだけでなく、商談したり噂話をしたりする社交の場でもあったんだ。皇帝が造った大規模な浴場もあって、今で言えば銭湯と喫茶店とジムを一つにしたようなものかな。「風呂は庶民の娯楽だった」と言われるのは、そのためなんだろうね。
cards.en: The public baths Romans went to every day apparently had really affordable prices. They say the entrance fee was kept very small so that even ordinary people could go casually. And a bath was not only a place to wash but also a social space for doing business and swapping gossip. There were also huge baths built by emperors, and in today's terms they were something like a sento, a cafe and a gym rolled into one. I suppose that's why people say bathing was a pastime of the common people.

words.defJa: 物事が持つ価値や重要な意味

cards.ja: 歴史を人前で話すとき、年号を並べるだけでは聞き手の心は動きません。大切なのは、その出来事が今日の私たちにとってどんな意義を持つのかを、最初の一分で示すことです。たとえば宗教改革なら、印刷術の普及に伴って「読む自由」が広がった点から入ると、話が急に身近になります。構成を考える段階で、まず結論の一文を紙に書いてみてください。最後に、話し終えたあとで聞き手が持ち帰る一言を決めておくと、全体が締まります。
cards.en: When you speak about history in public, simply lining up dates will not move your listeners. What matters is to show, in the first minute, what significance the event holds for us today. For the Reformation, for instance, if you begin with how the spread of printing widened the freedom to read, the story suddenly feels close. At the stage of planning your structure, first try writing your one-sentence conclusion on paper. Finally, if you decide in advance the one line the listener will take home after you finish, the whole talk tightens up.

words.defJa: 見聞きして心に浮かんだ思い

cards.ja: 新しい学習法を試した人に感想を聞くと、「成果より先に気分が軽くなった」と答える例が少なくない。成績の伸びを実感するまでには時間がかかるため、最初のうちは小さな達成感が続ける力を支えるからだ。ただし、それは本人の印象にすぎず、実際の成果とは別に確かめる必要がある。教育現場では、アンケートと標準的な試験の結果を併せて見る動きが広がりつつある。数字と声の両方を拾えばこそ、学びの全体像が見えてくる。
cards.en: When people who tried a new study method are asked for their impressions, many answer that their mood lifted before any results appeared. Because it takes time to feel one's grades improve, at first a small sense of achievement is what sustains the effort to continue. However, those are only the person's own impressions and must be checked separately from actual results. In schools, a trend is spreading toward looking at surveys together with standard test scores. Only by picking up both the numbers and the voices does the whole picture of learning come into view.

ruby: えるからだ。ただし、それは

cards.enTarget: When people who tried a new study method are asked for their impressions, many answer that their mood lifted before any results appeared.

words.defJa: 得することと損することの計算

cards.ja: 言葉を選ぶとき、私たちはしばしば損得勘定で動いている。「結構です」の一言が断りにも承諾にも聞こえるのは、相手との関係を壊さずに自分の立場を守るためだ。日本語の曖昧さは、そうした計算の積み重ねから生まれたとも言えよう。しかしこの曖昧さに安易に頼りすぎれば、肝心の本心が伝わらない恐れもある。だからこそ、打算を離れて本音を語る場面には、普段は隠れている言葉の本当の力が現れるのである。
cards.en: When choosing words, we often act on calculations of profit and loss. The reason a single remark like that's fine can sound like either refusal or acceptance is to protect one's position without damaging the relationship. One could say the ambiguity of Japanese was born from an accumulation of such calculations. But if we rely too easily on this ambiguity, there is a risk that our real feelings, the very point, will not get across. That is exactly why, in moments of speaking one's true mind apart from calculation, the real power of words that usually stays hidden appears.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「損得勘定」「損得抜きで」。利害を計算する場面に使う。
cards.enTarget: When choosing words, we often act on calculations of profit and loss.

words.defJa: 筋道が合わないこと

cards.ja: 『韓非子』には、楚の商人が「どんな盾も突き通す矛」と「どんな矛も防ぐ盾」を同時に売り歩いたという話がある。客に「ではその矛でその盾を突いたらどうなる」と尋ねられ、商人は答えに詰まった。この故事から、つじつまの合わない状態を矛盾と呼ぶようになり、今では政治の議論から日常の口論に至るまで広く使われている。矛と盾という具体的な道具が、抽象的な論理の言葉に化けた例である。
cards.en: The Han Feizi tells of a merchant of Chu who went around selling both a spear that could pierce any shield and a shield that could stop any spear. When a customer asked what would happen if that spear struck that shield, the merchant was left without an answer. From this tale, a state where things do not add up came to be called mujun, and today it is widely used from political debate to everyday quarrels. It is an example of concrete tools, a spear and a shield, turning into a word of abstract logic.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「矛盾する」「矛盾点」。故事成語。言うことと行いが食い違う場合にも使う。
cards.enTarget: From this tale, a state where things do not add up came to be called mujun, and today it is widely used from political debate to everyday quarrels.

words.defJa: 舞台や物語に姿を現すこと

cards.ja: 新しい習慣が生活に登場すれば、古い習慣は席を譲らざるを得ない。だが、相手は黙って去ってくれるわけではない。早起きを始めようと決意すると、夜更かしという悪癖が、あれこれと理由をつけて反撃してくる。習慣とは、意志の弱さの問題である以前に、脳が省エネのために選んできた回路なのである。だからこそ、新しい行動は、古い行動の置き換えとして、前もって丁寧に設計する必要がある。
cards.en: When a new habit enters your life, an old habit has no choice but to give up its seat. But the other does not go quietly. When you try to start rising early, the bad habit of staying up late counterattacks with one excuse after another. A habit is, before it is a matter of weak will, a circuit the brain has chosen to save energy. That is exactly why a new behavior must be designed as a replacement for an old one.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: ってくれるわけではない。
なのである。だからこそ、
cards.tipJa: 「新製品が登場する」「登場人物」。新しいものが現れる、舞台に出る意味。
cards.enTarget: When a new habit enters your life, an old habit has no choice but to give up its seat.

words.defJa: 活気にあふれて元気なさま

cards.ja: 退職をきっかけに畑を借りて野菜を育て始めた人たちが、現役のころより生き生きしていると、地域の高齢者支援の担当者は話す。毎朝決まった時刻に畑へ出る習慣が、生活のリズムを整えているのだという。借り賃が手頃で、収穫物を近所に配る楽しみもあり、会話の相手が増えたことが気持ちの張りにつながっているようだ。心理学では、役割と日課を持つことが、心の健康を保つ大きな支えになると考えられている。
cards.en: People who rented a plot and began growing vegetables after retirement are livelier than when they were working, says a local official in charge of supporting the elderly. The habit of going out to the field at a set time each morning is said to be setting the rhythm of daily life. The rent is affordable, there is the pleasure of handing out the harvest to neighbors, and having more people to talk to seems to be linked to a sense of vigor. In psychology, having a role and a routine is considered a major support for keeping mental health.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: りにつながっているようだ。
cards.tipJa: 「生き生きと働く・描く」。活力や、描写の鮮明さを表す。
cards.enTarget: People who rented a plot and began growing vegetables after retirement are livelier than when they were working, says a local official in charge of supporting the elderly.

words.defJa: 注意や関心の集まる中心

cards.ja: 話が散らかる原因の多くは、焦点が決まっていないことにある。話し始める前に、聞き手に持ち帰ってほしい一点を決めておくに越したことはない。その一点は、箇条書きにせず、一文で言えるかどうか試してみるとよい。言えないなら、材料がどれほど面白くても、聞き手の頭には何も残らない。写真を撮る前にレンズのピントを合わせるのと同じで、順序を間違えると、あとの努力が報われにくい。
cards.en: Much of what makes a talk scattered is that its focus has not been decided. Before you begin, it never hurts to decide the one point you want your listeners to take home. Try seeing whether you can state that one point in a single sentence rather than as a bulleted list. If you cannot, however interesting your material, nothing will remain in the listener's head. Just as you set the focus before taking a photograph, if you get the order wrong, the effort that follows is hard to reward.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: まっていないことにある。
cards.tipJa: 「焦点を絞る」「焦点が定まる」。話や議論の中心を写真のピントにたとえる。
cards.enTarget: Much of what makes a talk scattered is that its focus has not been decided.

words.defJa: 地位や年齢が自分より下の人

cards.ja: 話し方に人柄が出るのは、目下の人に向かって話すときである。上役には誰もが丁寧に話すが、立場の弱い相手にも率直で礼儀正しい調子を保てる人は、案外少ない。『論語』には、孔子がある重臣を評して、下の者に教えを請うことを恥じない人だと述べた箇所がある。言葉づかいは、相手を映す鏡である以前に、自分の器を映す鏡なのだ。下の者への一言には、その人の日ごろの心がけが、隠しようもなく表れる。
cards.en: A person's character shows in how they speak to those beneath them. Everyone speaks politely to a superior, but few people can keep a frank and courteous tone even with someone in a weaker position. In the Analects, there is a passage where Confucius, assessing a certain high official, says he was a man who was not ashamed to seek instruction from those below him. Your choice of words is a mirror of your own caliber before it is a mirror of the other person. A single remark to someone below reveals, unmistakably, the speaker's everyday attitude.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 対義語は「目上」。ここでは「もっか（今のところ）」ではなく「めした」と読む。
cards.sense: 地位や年齢が下の人（目上の対）
cards.enTarget: A person's character shows in how they speak to those beneath them.

words.defJa: 程度がいっそう深くなる

cards.ja: 訪日客の増加とともに、日本語を学ぶ外国人が各地の教室に集まるようになった。授業を重ねるうちに敬語の使い分けへの関心が深まり、「なぜ同じ『食べる』に三つの言い方があるのか」と率直に尋ねる受講生が増えたという。教える側も、文法の説明だけでは足りないと感じ、場面ごとの会話練習を取り入れつつある。言葉への理解は、辞書の中ではなく、使う場面を知ってはじめて確かなものになる。
cards.en: As visitors to Japan increase, more foreigners studying Japanese are filling classrooms in various places. As lessons accumulate, interest in using honorifics correctly has deepened, and more students are reportedly asking frankly, "Why are there three ways to say 'eat'?" Teachers, too, feel that explaining grammar alone is not enough and are bringing in conversation practice for each setting. Understanding of a language becomes solid not in the dictionary but only when you know the situations in which it is used.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「関心・理解・対立・秋」が深まる。自然に程度が増す変化を表す自動詞。
cards.enTarget: As lessons accumulate, interest in using honorifics correctly has deepened, and more students are reportedly asking frankly, "Why are there three ways to say 'eat'?"

words.defJa: 色や行動が目立って華やかなこと

cards.ja: 新しいチップの発表会って、毎回やたら派手じゃないですか。照明を落としたステージに経営者が革ジャンで登場して、棒グラフがどーんと映る。でも本当に見るべきなのは演出じゃなくて、電力あたりの性能なんですよね。華やかな売り文句に釣られて買ったら、速いどころか、前の機種とほとんど変わらなかったって話も聞きますよ。宣伝の上手さと製品の出来は、案外まったく別のものだったりします。
cards.en: Chip launch events are always weirdly flashy, aren't they? An executive walks onto a darkened stage in a leather jacket and a huge bar chart flashes up. But what you should really look at isn't the show, it's the performance per watt. I've even heard of people who fell for the glossy sales pitch, bought one, and found it was hardly different from the previous model, let alone faster. Skill at promotion and the quality of the product can turn out to be quite separate things.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: のものだったりします。
cards.tipJa: 演出や見た目が目立つさま。「派手な〜」「派手に〜する」の形でよく使う。
cards.enTarget: Chip launch events are always weirdly flashy, aren't they?

words.defJa: 食事に出す料理の組み合わせ

cards.ja: 歴史の年号を覚えるとき、献立にたとえる人がいます。主菜は大きな出来事、副菜は人物、汁物は背景というように、食卓に並べて整理するのです。実際、江戸時代の武家の宴席に出された本膳料理は、飯と汁と菜を決まった位置に置く厳格な配置でした。位置が決まっていればこそ、並べ方そのものが記憶の手がかりになります。バラバラの知識も、置き場所を与えれば取り出しやすくなるんです。
cards.en: Some people compare memorizing historical dates to a menu. Main dish for the big event, side dish for the person, soup for the background; you arrange them on the table to organize them. Indeed, the honzen cuisine of Edo-period samurai households was served in a strict layout with rice, soup and side dishes in fixed positions. Precisely because the positions are fixed, the arrangement itself becomes a clue for memory. Even scattered knowledge becomes easier to retrieve once you give it a place to sit.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: がかりになります。バラバラの
cards.tipJa: 「今日の献立」「献立を立てる」。食事の料理の組み合わせや予定を指す。
cards.enTarget: Some people compare memorizing historical dates to a menu.

words.defJa: かざらず正直なさま

cards.ja: ラマナ・マハルシは、弟子の質問に驚くほど率直に答えた人でした。弟子たちが懸命に修行法を尋ねても、彼の答えはいつも同じで、「私とは誰か」と自分自身に問いなさい、というものです。難しい理論を並べるかわりに、問いそのものを差し出したのです。答えは外の本ではなく、問いを向けた先の自分の内側にある、というのが彼の立場でした。知識を積むより、問う人自身を見つめよという教えは、アドヴァイタの伝統にも深く根ざしています。
cards.en: Ramana Maharshi was a man who answered his disciples' questions with striking frankness. However earnestly they asked about methods of practice, his answer was always the same: ask yourself, "Who am I?" Instead of laying out difficult theory, he handed over the question itself. His position was that the answer lies not in outside books but within oneself, where the question is directed. A teaching that says to look at the one who asks rather than pile up knowledge is also deeply rooted in the Advaita tradition.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: いなさい、というものです。
cards.tipJa: 「率直に言う」「率直な意見」。遠回しにせず正直に伝える態度。
cards.enTarget: Ramana Maharshi was a man who answered his disciples' questions with striking frankness.

words.defJa: 体の表面をおおう組織

cards.ja: インドの伝統医学アーユルヴェーダには、ウコンやニームを使った皮膚の手入れの知恵が数多く伝わっている。近年は、こうした素材を使った化粧品や石けんが、国内市場に加えて海外でも売り上げを伸ばしている。ただし、伝統的な使い方がすべて科学的に裏づけられているわけではなく、成分の濃度や安全性の測定は、依然として課題とされる。消費者に求められるのは、歴史の長さを根拠に過信せず、表示を確かめる冷静さである。
cards.en: Ayurveda, India's traditional medicine, passes down a great deal of knowledge about skin care using turmeric and neem. In recent years cosmetics and soaps using such ingredients have been increasing sales abroad in addition to the domestic market. However, not every traditional use is scientifically backed, and the concentration of ingredients and the measurement of safety remain issues. What is asked of consumers is the calm to check the labels rather than overtrust a product on the length of its history.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: アーユルヴェーダには、ウコンやニームを
づけられているわけではなく、
cards.tipJa: 「皮膚炎」「皮膚科」「皮膚感覚」。医学や化粧品の文脈で使う硬めの語。
cards.enTarget: Ayurveda, India's traditional medicine, passes down a great deal of knowledge about skin care using turmeric and neem.

words.defJa: こわれて飛び散った小さな部分

cards.ja: 古い言葉は、土の中から出てきた割れた器の破片に似ている。一つひとつは小さくて用をなさないものの、拾い集めて合わせてみると、かつての暮らしの形が、ぼんやりと浮かび上がってくる。「やばい」も「かわいい」も、今の意味に落ち着くまでには、さまざまな意味の層をくぐってきた。語源をたどる作業とは、言葉の断片を手がかりに、失われた全体像を推し量ろうとする試みにほかならない。
cards.en: Old words resemble the fragments of a broken vessel dug out of the earth. Each piece is small and useless on its own, but when you gather them and fit them together, the shape of life as it once was surfaces faintly. Both yabai and kawaii passed through layers of various meanings before settling into their present senses. Tracing etymology is nothing other than an attempt to infer a lost whole from fragments of words.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: わせてみると、かつての
がってくる。「やばい」も「かわいい」も、
くまでには、さまざまな
cards.tipJa: 「ガラスの破片」。割れて飛び散った小さな部分。比喩で言葉や記憶にも使う。
cards.enTarget: Old words resemble the fragments of a broken vessel dug out of the earth.

words.defJa: 新聞や雑誌を初めて出すこと

cards.ja: 新聞や雑誌の発刊は、世界史の資料問題でよく問われます。たとえば日本では、一八七二年に東京日日新聞が創刊されたのをはじめ、各地で新聞が相次いで生まれ、文明開化の空気の中で新しいメディアが広がりました。覚えるときは、年号だけを暗記するのではなく、なぜその時期に出されたのかを短く一言添えておくのがコツです。背景とセットにした知識は、問われ方が変わっても応用が利きます。
cards.en: The launch of newspapers and magazines is often asked about in source questions on world history. In Japan, for example, starting with the Tokyo Nichinichi Shimbun in 1872, newspapers appeared one after another in various places, and a new medium spread in the atmosphere of civilization and enlightenment. When memorizing, the trick is not just to cram the year but to add a phrase on why it was launched at that time. Knowledge paired with its background can be applied even if the question is worded differently.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: するのではなく、なぜその
えておくのがコツです。
cards.tipJa: 「創刊」とほぼ同じ。「月刊誌を発刊する」「発刊の辞」など出版で使う。
cards.enTarget: The launch of newspapers and magazines is often asked about in source questions on world history.

words.defJa: 県の行政を行う役所

cards.ja: 一八七一年の廃藩置県によって、それまでの藩は県に置き換えられ、各地に県庁が置かれた。中央政府が任命した官吏が派遣され、行政の中央集権化に伴って、地方の統治は一気に国の管理下に入った。その所在地には、旧藩の城下町がそのまま選ばれた例が多く、今日の県都の多くにその名残が見られる。のちに役所が別の都市へ移転した例もあるが、全体としては、旧藩の骨格が現在の地図に生きている。その後の統廃合を経て、県の数と区域は現在の四十七都道府県に落ち着いた。
cards.en: With the abolition of the domains and establishment of prefectures in 1871, the former domains were replaced by prefectures and prefectural offices were set up across the land. Officials appointed by the central government were dispatched, and with the centralization of administration, local governance came under national control all at once. In many cases the old castle town of a domain was chosen as the seat, and traces of this remain in many of today's prefectural capitals. There are cases where the office later moved to another city, but overall the skeleton of the old domains lives on in today's map. Through later mergers and reorganizations, the number and areas of prefectures settled at today's forty-seven.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「県庁所在地」「県庁職員」。県の行政の中心となる役所とその建物。
cards.enTarget: With the abolition of the domains and establishment of prefectures in 1871, the former domains were replaced by prefectures and prefectural offices were set up across the land.

words.meaning: to float; to be left over
words.defJa: 水面や空中にとどまる。余りが出る

cards.ja: 生成AIが議事録や下書きを肩代わりしてくれるようになり、一日に浮く時間は確実に増えた。ところが、その時間で人は本当に考えているだろうか。空いた余白をすぐ別の作業で埋めてしまうなら、効率化は深い思索をもたらすどころか、忙しさを増すだけに終わる。節約された時間は、使い道を問われてはじめて意義を持つのである。少し立ち止まって何もしない時間を持てるかどうかが、これからの知的な贅沢を分けるだろう。
cards.en: Generative AI now takes over the minutes and the first drafts, and the time freed up each day has certainly grown. But are people really using that time to think? If the spare room is immediately filled with other tasks, efficiency brings not deep reflection but only more busyness. Saved time takes on meaning only once we are asked what it is for. Whether one can pause and keep some time to do nothing may well separate the intellectual luxuries of the years ahead.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: わりしてくれるようになり、
てるかどうかが、これからの
cards.tipJa: 「時間・お金・費用が浮く」は余りが出る意味。水に浮く意味とは別の用法。
cards.sense: 余りが出る（時間・お金が浮く）
cards.enTarget: Generative AI now takes over the minutes and the first drafts, and the time freed up each day has certainly grown.

words.defJa: 目当て。ねらった目的

cards.ja: 文章を書くとき、最初に問うべきなのは、何を書くかではなく、何のために書くかである。その狙いがはっきりしない文章は、どれほど美しい言葉を並べても、読み終えたあとに何も残らない。逆に、目的が一つに絞られていれば、控え目な表現や多少ぎこちない言い回しでも、読者は最後まで運ばれていく。名文の技巧とは、その目的に仕えているにすぎない。書き手が磨くべきは、飾りより先に、この一点なのである。
cards.en: When you write, the first thing to ask is not what to write but what you are writing for. A piece whose aim is unclear leaves nothing behind once it has been read, however beautiful the words lined up. Conversely, if the purpose is narrowed to one thing, readers are carried to the end even by modest phrasing or somewhat awkward turns. The craft of fine prose is nothing more than serving that purpose. What a writer should polish, before any ornament, is this one point.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「狙いは〜にある」「狙いを定める」。もともとは的に向ける意味から。
cards.enTarget: A piece whose aim is unclear leaves nothing behind once it has been read, however beautiful the words lined up.

words.defJa: 役所などに願い出ること

cards.ja: 制度を覚えるのが苦手な人は、「誰が、誰に、何を申請するのか」という形に直しておくと、制度を整理する上で役に立ちます。たとえば江戸初期の朱印船貿易は、商人が幕府に願い出て朱印状を受け取らなければ、海外へ渡れない仕組みでした。この場合、願い出る側は商人、許可を出す側は幕府です。登場人物と動作を決めてしまえば、制度は一つの小さな物語になります。年号の暗記より先に、こうした骨組みを押さえておくと、応用も利きます。
cards.en: If you find institutions hard to memorize, recasting them as "who applies to whom for what" helps you organize them. For example, early Edo red-seal ship trade was a system in which merchants could not go abroad unless they petitioned the shogunate and received a red-seal permit. In this case the petitioner is the merchant and the one who grants permission is the shogunate. Once you fix the characters and the action, an institution becomes one small story. Grasping this framework before cramming years makes it easier to apply.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「申請書」「ビザを申請する」。役所への正式な願い出を表す。
cards.enTarget: If you find institutions hard to memorize, recasting them as "who applies to whom for what" helps you organize them.

words.defJa: 水中や物の下に入る。人目を避けて隠れる

cards.ja: 江戸幕府が禁教令を出したあと、日本の信者たちは、表向きは仏教徒を装いながら信仰を守り続けました。彼らは社会の表から姿を消し、人目につかない暮らしの底に潜る道を選んだのです。家の納戸には聖母に見立てた観音像を祀り、祈りの言葉は口伝えで残しました。約二百五十年を経た一八六五年、長崎の大浦天主堂で、その子孫たちが神父に信仰を打ち明けました。外から見えない信仰が世代を超えて受け継がれた例として、世界史上の意義が大きい出来事です。
cards.en: After the shogunate issued its ban on Christianity, believers in Japan kept their faith while outwardly posing as Buddhists. They vanished from the surface of society and chose to sink into a life that drew no attention. In the storerooms of their homes they enshrined Kannon figures made to stand for the Virgin, and kept their prayers alive by word of mouth. After about 250 years, in 1865, their descendants confessed their faith to a priest at Oura Church in Nagasaki. It is an event of great significance in world history as an example of a faith invisible from outside being handed down across generations.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「地下に潜る」「人混みに潜る」。水中以外に、人目を避けて隠れる意味も持つ。
cards.enTarget: They vanished from the surface of society and chose to sink into a life that drew no attention.

words.defJa: 物質の含まれる割合

cards.ja: 半導体の工場では、空気中の微粒子の濃度が厳しく管理されている。最先端のチップを作るクリーンルームでは、一立方メートルあたりの粒子の数を測定し、基準を外れれば工程を見直す。髪の毛の太さの千分の一にも満たない塵が、回路の線を断ち切ってしまうからだ。作業服から清掃の手順に至るまで、細かな決まりが定められている。製品の品質は、目に見えない空気の質に静かに支えられている。
cards.en: In semiconductor plants, the concentration of fine particles in the air is tightly controlled. In the clean rooms where cutting-edge chips are made, the number of particles per cubic meter is measured and the process is reviewed if it falls outside the standard. This is because dust less than a thousandth of the thickness of a hair can sever the lines of a circuit. Detailed rules are set from work garments all the way to cleaning procedures. The quality of the product rests on the quality of air that cannot be seen.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: るクリーンルームでは、
cards.tipJa: 「濃度が高い／低い」「二酸化炭素濃度」。溶けているものや含まれる量の割合。
cards.enTarget: In semiconductor plants, the concentration of fine particles in the air is tightly controlled.

words.defJa: 夏に着る木綿の和服

cards.ja: 夏祭りの夜、浴衣姿の人々が提灯の灯る川沿いをそぞろ歩く光景は、いまや日本の風物詩である。もともとは貴族が蒸し風呂に入るときに着た湯帷子が起源とされ、江戸時代に銭湯が広まるのに伴って、風呂上がりの普段着として庶民に定着した。花火大会に着ていくようになったのはさらに後のことで、今では手頃な値段で揃える人も多い。衣服の意味は、着る場所や季節を移りながら、静かに変わってゆくものである。
cards.en: On a summer festival night, the sight of people strolling along the lantern-lit river in yukata has become a seasonal fixture of Japan. It is said to originate in the bath garment that nobles wore in steam baths, and as public baths spread in the Edo period it took hold among ordinary people as casual wear after a bath. Wearing it to fireworks displays came much later, and today many people buy a set at a reasonable price. The meaning of a garment shifts quietly as it moves from place to place.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

わってゆくものである。
cards.tipJa: 風呂上がりの普段着から夏祭りの装いへ。起源と用途の変化がこの語の背景。
cards.enTarget: On a summer festival night, the sight of people strolling along the lantern-lit river in yukata has become a seasonal fixture of Japan.

words.defJa: 場所や所有を移すこと

cards.ja: 歴史の年表には、「遷都」と単なる引っ越しとが、ごちゃ混ぜになって出てくることがあります。たとえば七九四年に桓武天皇が都を平安京に移した出来事は、一般に遷都と呼ばれます。一方、現代のニュースで首都機能の移転が議論されるとき、それは建物や省庁の引っ越しを指すことが多いです。文脈に応じて、政治的な意義を帯びた語なのか、物理的な移動を指す語なのかを見分けると、用語が整理されます。
cards.en: In historical chronologies, the relocation of a capital and a mere move sometimes appear jumbled together. For example, Emperor Kanmu's moving the capital to Heian-kyo in 794 is generally called a transfer of the capital. By contrast, when the relocation of capital functions is debated in today's news, it often means moving buildings and ministries. Depending on context, if you distinguish whether a word carries political significance or refers to physical movement, the terms fall into order.

words.defJa: 折り重ねて小さくする。店などを閉じる

cards.ja: 商店街の八百屋が、長年の営業を終えて店を畳むことになった。この動詞はもともと衣類を折りたたむ動作を指すが、広げていたものを小さくして片づける、という意味が転じて、廃業や会議の終結にも使われるようになった。傘や布団の扱いに加えて、商売の幕引きまで一語で言い表せるのは、日本語の比喩の力といえる。店主は最終日に、店への愛着を語る常連客一人ひとりに頭を下げて見送った。
cards.en: A greengrocer on the shopping street has decided to close its shop after long years in business. This verb originally refers to folding clothes, but its sense of making something that was spread out small and tidying it away has extended to closing a business or ending a meeting. That one word can express both handling an umbrella or futon and the end of a business is a sign of the power of Japanese metaphor. On the last day, the owner bowed to each regular customer who spoke of their attachment to the shop and saw them off.

cards.tipJa: 衣類・傘を畳むのほか、「店を畳む」は廃業の意味。広げたものを小さくする核。
cards.sense: 店などを閉じる（廃業する）
cards.enTarget: A greengrocer on the shopping street has decided to close its shop after long years in business.

words.meaning: to run into; to hit a wall
words.defJa: 進んでいって行き止まりにぶつかる

cards.ja: 日本の新幹線方式を採用するインドの高速鉄道計画は、ムンバイとアーメダバードを結ぶ路線で建設が段階的に進められている。しかし、用地の取得や住民の移転をめぐる地元との交渉に突き当たり、工期は当初の予定から大きく遅れることになった。インド政府は理解を求めてきたが、対立が完全に解けたとは言いがたい。巨大な計画ほど、技術の問題より、人の暮らしとの折り合いに思わぬ壁が現れやすい。
cards.en: India's high-speed rail project, which adopts the Japanese Shinkansen system, is under construction on a line linking Mumbai and Ahmedabad. But it ran into negotiations with locals over land acquisition and resettlement, and the schedule slipped well behind the original plan. The Indian government has sought understanding, but it can hardly be said that the dispute has been completely resolved. The bigger the project, the more readily a wall appears not in technology but in the need to reconcile with people's lives.

cards.sense: 困難に直面する（壁に突き当たる）
cards.enTarget: But it ran into negotiations with locals over land acquisition and resettlement, and the schedule slipped well behind the original plan.

words.defJa: 魚や貝をとる産業

cards.ja: 衛星画像と機械学習を使えば、海の上で何が起きているかを、人間の目よりも広く見張ることができる。たとえば違法な漁業は、船が位置信号を切って闇に紛れても、動きのパターンから見破られるようになってきた。技術は、海の監視という長年の難題に、ようやく手が届く形を与えたのである。とはいえ、監視できることと、取り締まれることは別の問題だ。指定された海域で何が見えたとしても、それにどう応えるかは、最後まで人間の判断にかかっている。
cards.en: With satellite imagery and machine learning, what is happening on the sea can be watched over a wider area than human eyes could cover. Illegal fishing, for example, has come to be detected from movement patterns even when a vessel switches off its position signal and slips into the dark. Technology has finally given the long-standing problem of monitoring the ocean a shape within reach. That said, being able to monitor and being able to enforce are separate matters. Even when something is seen in a designated sea area, how to respond rests with human judgment to the end.

words.meaning: to glare at; to keep an eye on
words.defJa: 鋭く見る。警戒して見張る

cards.ja: インドは、隣国の軍事的な動きを睨む形で、国境地帯の道路や空港の整備を急いでいる。ヒマラヤの標高の高い地域でも、年間を通じて物資を運べる道が増えれば、兵站の負担は大きく変わると、政府筋はみる。一方で、こうした整備は周辺の自然環境に影響を及ぼす恐れがあり、地元住民からは懸念の声も上がっている。安全保障と環境の両立は、今後も長く、難しい課題であり続けるだろう。計画の是非は、地図の上ではなく、現地の暮らしの中で問われることになる。
cards.en: India is rushing to build up roads and airports in border areas with an eye on a neighbor's military movements. Even in high Himalayan regions, if more roads can carry supplies all year round, the burden of logistics would change greatly, government sources believe. On the other hand, such development risks affecting the surrounding natural environment, and local residents have raised concerns. Balancing security and the environment will remain a difficult issue for a long time. The merits of a plan will be tested not on the map but in the daily lives of the places concerned.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「相手の動きを睨む」は警戒して見張ること。目つきの「睨む」とは別の比喩用法。
cards.sense: 警戒して見張る（動向を睨む）
cards.enTarget: India is rushing to build up roads and airports in border areas with an eye on a neighbor's military movements.

words.defJa: 力を加えて細かくする

cards.ja: 半導体の材料になる高純度のシリコンは、棒状に育てた塊を砕いて小さな破片にしてから、るつぼで溶かされる。原料のほんのわずかな汚れが、のちの回路の性能を左右するため、濃度のごく低い不純物さえ許されない。そこから作られた円柱状の巨大な結晶を薄く切り出したものが、いわゆるウェハーである。原料はもちろん、作業に使う道具に至るまで、工程のはじめから細心の注意が払われている。
cards.en: High-purity silicon, the material of semiconductors, is smashed from rods grown as blocks into small fragments before being melted in a crucible. Because a slight contamination of the raw material affects the performance of the circuits later, even impurities at very low concentration are not tolerated. The cylindrical crystal made from it, sliced thin, is what is called a wafer. From the raw material to the tools used in the work, the utmost care is taken from the very start of the process.

cards.tipJa: 「岩・氷・夢・常識を砕く」。固いものを力で細かくする。
cards.enTarget: High-purity silicon, the material of semiconductors, is smashed from rods grown as blocks into small fragments before being melted in a crucible.

words.defJa: 器具で長さや量を測ること

cards.ja: 日本語の話す速さを測定するときは、文字数ではなく、拍の数で数えるのが一般的である。拍とは、「きって」が「き」「っ」「て」の三つに数えられるような、一定の長さの音の単位をいう。この方法を通して、同じ人でも朗読と雑談では速さが変わることが、数字で確かめられる。速さの数字は有力な手がかりだが、それだけでは、聞き手が聞き取りやすいと感じるかどうかまでは分からない。間の取り方も、同じくらい重要な要素である。
cards.en: When measuring how fast Japanese is spoken, it is usual to count morae rather than characters. A mora is a unit of sound of fixed length, as when kitte is counted as three: ki, small tsu and te. Through this method it can be confirmed in numbers that even the same person speaks at different speeds when reading aloud and when chatting. The speed figure is a strong clue, but by itself it cannot tell us whether listeners find the speech easy to follow. How pauses are placed is an element just as important.

words.defJa: ごみやよごれを取り除くこと

cards.ja: ガンディーは、自分の使う便所の清掃を、他人任せにしなかったことで知られています。話し方を磨きたい人にも、この逸話から学べることがあります。人に何かを呼びかけるとき、言葉の説得力を決めるのは、声の大きさというより、語る本人が何を実践しているかです。どれほど見事な話を披露しても、行いが伴わなければ、聞き手はすぐに見抜きます。便所掃除のような地味な行いこそ、言葉に重みを与える土台になるのです。
cards.en: Gandhi is known for not leaving the cleaning of the latrine he used to others. Those who want to polish their way of speaking can also learn something from this anecdote. When you appeal to people, what decides the persuasiveness of your words is not the volume of your voice but what the speaker is practicing. However brilliant a speech you give, if your conduct does not match, listeners see through it at once. Plain deeds like cleaning a toilet are the very foundation that gives words weight.

しているかです。どれほど

cards.enTarget: Gandhi is known for not leaving the cleaning of the latrine he used to others.

words.defJa: 謝る気持ちを表す。言いわけが立たない

cards.ja: 誤回答で利用者に損害が出たとき、「申し訳ない」と頭を下げるだけでは、企業の説明責任は果たせない。「システムの不具合により」という主語のない言い方は、人間の判断の誤りを機械の問題にすり替えてしまう。二〇二四年には、カナダの航空会社がチャットボットの誤案内をめぐって、賠償を命じられた。故意ではなくとも、AIを導入する以上、その発言が生む信頼の損失は企業が負うほかない。
cards.en: When a wrong answer causes a user harm, bowing and saying "I'm sorry" is not enough to discharge a company's accountability. The subjectless phrasing "due to a system malfunction" swaps a human error of judgment for a problem of the machine. In 2024, a Canadian airline was ordered to pay damages over incorrect guidance from its chatbot. Even if it was not intentional, once a company adopts AI, it has no choice but to bear the loss of trust that AI's statements create.

words.defJa: 進んで働きかけないさま

cards.ja: インド哲学の「無執着」という教えは、消極的な生き方だと誤解されがちです。ところがヨーガの教えでは、損得の計算や結果への執着を手放すことこそが、行動を最も力強くするとされます。『バガヴァッド・ギーター』で、戦士アルジュナは戦うことをためらいますが、クリシュナは行為そのものを捧げ物として果たせと説きます。何もしないのではなく、実りを求めずにやり抜く、これが彼の言う道です。
cards.en: The Indian teaching of non-attachment tends to be misread as a passive way of life. Yet in yoga, letting go of calculations of gain and loss and of attachment to results is said to make action most powerful. In the Bhagavad Gita, the warrior Arjuna hesitates to fight, but Krishna tells him to carry out the act itself as an offering. It is not doing nothing but seeing it through without seeking the fruit, and that is the path he describes.

cards.enTarget: The Indian teaching of non-attachment tends to be misread as a passive way of life.

words.defJa: たがいに働きかけ合うこと

cards.ja: 心と体は、どちらか一方が他方を動かす主従の関係ではなく、相互に影響を及ぼし合っている。緊張すれば胃を痛め、胃を痛めれば気分が沈む。この循環は、心と体をあたかも別々のものであるかのように扱ってきた近代の見方に、静かな疑問を投げかける。仏教が古くから心身を一つの流れとして捉えてきたのは、こうした実感に根ざしていたからであろう。身体の感覚を整える修行が心を静めるのも、この循環を逆向きに使っているからだ。
cards.en: Mind and body are not in a master-and-servant relation where one moves the other; they influence each other mutually. Tension upsets the stomach, and an upset stomach sinks the mood. This cycle quietly questions the modern view that has treated mind and body as if they were separate things. That Buddhism has long grasped mind and body as one flow was probably rooted in just this kind of felt reality. That practices which regulate bodily sensation calm the mind is because they use this cycle in reverse.

cards.enTarget: Mind and body are not in a master-and-servant relation where one moves the other; they influence each other mutually.

words.defJa: 座敷の広さを数える単位

cards.ja: 受験勉強をするなら、広い部屋より狭い部屋のほうが集中できる、という人は少なくありません。たとえば六畳ほどの部屋に机と本棚だけを揃えれば、視界に入る誘惑がぐっと減ります。環境を絞り込むと、意志の力に頼らなくても、やるべきことに自然と目が向くようになるのです。勉強の質は、時間の長さに限らず、場の設計によっても決まります。机の上に何も置かないという小さな工夫も、同じ発想です。
cards.en: Some people say that for exam study a small room helps concentration more than a big one. For example, if you furnish a room of about six tatami with only a desk and a bookshelf, the temptations in your field of view drop sharply. When you narrow down the environment, your eyes turn naturally to what you must do, even without relying on willpower. The quality of study is decided not only by how long you work but also by how the place is designed. The small trick of putting nothing on the desk comes from the same idea.

らなくても、やるべきことに
cards.tipJa: 部屋の広さは「六畳」「八畳」と数える。一畳は約一・六平方メートル。
cards.sense: 畳の枚数を数える助数詞
cards.enTarget: For example, if you furnish a room of about six tatami with only a desk and a bookshelf, the temptations in your field of view drop sharply.

words.defJa: 持つ力を十分に表に出すこと

cards.ja: 『バガヴァッド・ギーター』は、戦場で迷うアルジュナに、結果への執着を手放して行為そのものに集中せよ、と教えます。この態度は、現代の私たちが仕事で実力を発揮する場面にも、そのまま通じます。結果ばかり気にすると、体が固まって本来の力は出ません。損得に気を取られることなく目の前の動作に没頭したときにこそ、人は最もよく働くのです。二千年ほど前に成立した教えが、集中状態の研究と重なると指摘されることもあります。
cards.en: The Bhagavad Gita teaches Arjuna, wavering on the battlefield, to let go of attachment to results and concentrate on the act itself. This attitude applies directly to those of us who need to bring out our abilities at work today. If you fixate only on results, your body stiffens and your real strength does not come out. It is when we are absorbed in the movement in front of us, without being distracted by gain and loss, that we work best. It is sometimes pointed out that a teaching composed roughly two thousand years ago overlaps with research on states of deep focus.

cards.enTarget: This attitude applies directly to those of us who need to bring out our abilities at work today.

words.defJa: 普通と違って特別なさま

cards.ja: 勉強が得意な人って、生まれつきの、何か特殊な才能があるように見えますよね。でも学習科学の研究では、成績を分けるのは、才能というより、思い出す練習を何回したかだと言われています。教科書を読み返すだけでは、わかった気になるだけで、記憶には定着しにくいんです。問題を解いて、間違えて、また解き直す。この一見地味なくり返しこそが、本番で力を発揮する確かな近道になります。
cards.en: People who are good at studying seem to have some special talent, don't they? But learning-science research says what separates grades is less talent than how many times you practiced recalling. Just rereading the textbook only makes you feel you understand, and it hardly sticks in memory. You solve problems, get them wrong, and solve them again. It is precisely this plain repetition that becomes the shortcut to showing your strength on the day.
